prerequisites.title: Free Xero account and test organisation
prerequisites.detail: Sign up for a free Xero account, then use the demo company (recommended) or a trial or paid organisation for free development.

prerequisites.title: 10 beta customers
prerequisites.detail: Xero's blog says you must onboard 10 beta customers (non-demo tenants with recent API calls) before the application form unlocks.

prerequisites.title: Sign Up with Xero implemented
prerequisites.detail: This must be done before you submit the listing for review. Sign in with Xero also covers the minimum two-step authentication requirement.

prerequisites.title: Stripe and regions for paid subscriptions
prerequisites.detail: If you sell through App Store Subscriptions, set up Stripe and target regions first. It is currently available only in Australia, New Zealand and the UK.

steps.title: Create Xero developer account and app
steps.detail: Sign up for a free Xero account and register an OAuth 2.0 app to get a client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: You hold a client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Get redirect URI from Composio
steps.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and check it is absolute, with no wildcard. Up to 50 URIs can be registered.
steps.done_when: The URI is registered in the Xero app.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the xero auth config through Composio's API with your own client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: A test user can connect a demo company.

steps.title: Handle token expiry in the agent
steps.detail: Refresh tokens so none sits unused for 60 days. If a refresh gets no response, retry with the old token for up to 30 minutes.

steps.title: Onboard 10 beta customers
steps.detail: Get 10 real Xero organisations connected and making API calls.
steps.done_when: The application form unlocks in the Developer Centre.

steps.title: Apply to App Partner Program
steps.detail: Submit the company and app details and complete certification with Xero.
steps.done_when: Xero accepts you as an app partner.

steps.title: Draft security assessment answers
steps.detail: Prepare answers on authentication, encryption, audit logging and personnel security, plus listing text for you to review.
steps.done_when: A draft is ready for human review.

steps.title: Submit assessment and listing
steps.detail: Submit the assessment and the listing in the Developer Centre. Expect a possible walkthrough interview about how client tokens are held.

steps.title: Wait for Xero's review
steps.detail: Xero takes 5-10 working days to assess answers and emails the result. If it fails, you get 30 days for a remediation plan and 60 days to fix.

traps.title: Annual reassessment
traps.detail: The security assessment must be repeated every year, so plan recurring work.

traps.title: Unused refresh tokens expire after 60 days
traps.detail: Users of rarely used agents must reauthorise after 60 days of inactivity.

traps.title: Cap before approval
traps.detail: A developer report says unapproved apps are capped near 25 clients, and reviews get deeper above 100 and 1,000 users.

traps.title: Failing the first assessment is costly
traps.detail: Remediation allows 30 days for a plan and 60 days to implement, then Xero re-reviews.

traps.title: Some APIs are reviewed regardless of size
traps.detail: All consumers of the Practice Manager, HQ and Tax APIs are affected with no connection threshold. Xero may also require an assessment from others.

blockers.symptom: Application form is locked in the Developer Centre
blockers.what_it_means: You have not yet onboarded 10 beta customers.
blockers.what_to_do: Connect 10 real, non-demo organisations that make API calls.

blockers.what_it_means: Some items did not meet the standard.
blockers.what_to_do: Send a remediation plan within 30 days and implement fixes within 60 days.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the remediation plan from the report.
